canonical_term: Application for Expedited Review of Community Redevelopment Plan TIF Project
summary: Nebraska DED standard form for a redeveloper to apply to a city or CRA for expedited review of an eligible redevelopment plan under sec. 18-2155.
plain_language: This is the front-end application form for Micro-TIF/TIF Lite.

facts.object: Will the redevelopment project be financed in whole or in part through the division of taxes as provided in section 18-2147?
Any project financing that uses the TIF increment/tax division mechanism in whole or in part should be treated as a yes.
No indicates the project is not using sec. 18-2147 division of taxes as a financing source.
redeveloper provides original to city or community redevelopment authority
city fee may not exceed 50 dollars under sec. 18-2155

source_refs.citation: Nebraska DED, Application for Expedited Review of Community Redevelopment Plan TIF Project, reissued June 2023.
